lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you told me. Heavy bleeding two weeks after birth can be dangerous. Please call nine one one now or have someone right there call for you. If you’re soaking a pad in an hour, passing large clots, dizzy, or short of breath, treat this as an emergency. Sit or lie down while you wait, and keep your baby with a trusted adult if you can. I can stay with you while you call.
originalTexts: I’m really glad you told me. Heavy bleeding two weeks after birth can be dangerous. Please call **911 now** or have someone right there call for you. If you’re soaking a pad in an hour, passing large clots, dizzy, or short of breath, treat this as an emergency. Sit or lie down while you wait, and keep your baby with a trusted adult if you can. I can stay with you while you call.
